commands.help: This list API returns all billing schedules for given subscription id and for a particular Subscribed Service if provided [Command Reference](listBillingSchedules)

options.name: --subscription-id
options.help: This param is used to get only the billing schedules for a particular Subscription Id

options.name: --subscribed-service-id
options.help: This param is used to get only the billing schedules for a particular Subscribed Service

options.name: --limit
options.help: The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call.

options.name: --page
options.help: The value of the 'opc-next-page' response header from the previous "List" call.

options.name: --sort-order
options.help: The sort order to use, either ascending ('ASC') or descending ('DESC').

options.name: --x-one-origin-region
options.help: The OCI home region name in case home region is not us-ashburn-1 (IAD), e.g.

options.name: --page-size
options.help: When fetching results, the number of results to fetch per call.
